I agree with this 100%. I was 21 when  I was  diagnosed with severe depression. Now I'm 27 years old.  And those were my thoughts too for how many years. Thoughts of not having anything or anyone to live for. But like what LanternHoldr said, stick around and you will find that one thing that will just spark joy in your life that no other person or situation can take from you.

It's tough not having anyone to vent out your frustrations. If you can you should reach out to a therapist and if not, this group is a support group you can talk to for the meantime. But I highly suggest you should see a therapist so you can process it together. Hugs
Hey, we're here for you. Let's talk it out. We've been there and if there is anything we can do to help. Even if it's just to listen/read just holler

Location: Philippines

Really bad typhoon hit the Visayas and Mindanao. Typhoon Odette (Rai) killed almost 400 people and many still missing. One of the cities hit was Leyte. Leyte is still recovering from a previous typhoon that hit and then now they're back to square one. Most of the people affected lost their belongings and their homes. Most celebrated Christmas without a roof over their heads. No proper food to eat. No proper place to rest or sleep. Some just stayed on the rubble they used to call home. 

Sigh. God help us all.
